kind: shared block for every experiments/configs/samedata_*.json (same-data, same-protocol comparisons on published open datasets)
declared: drafted by Opus 5.5 (Claude) on 2026-10-07 (PDT) as a benchmark-preparation worker, before any fit on these datasets. Becomes binding only when the owner approves, the orchestrator commits it, and status is set to 'declared'.
authority: none yet. Brief (Oct 7): 'You PREPARE; you do NOT train or score any model on these labels (that would break pre-registration).' Running needs a human go + committed configs (banned: running a round without a committed config).
banned_moves_note: Selection is by mean across repeats, never by CI, never by a single seed or split. The single published split (P1_pub) is reported, never selected on, never the claim.
No 'beats SOTA' anywhere; 'comparable' is a human decision; numbers_of_record.json, leaderboard.csv and the xlsx files are not touched by these rounds (external checks, not Dravix targets).
Row exclusions are fixed now, by label-free rules only. No row, paper or molecule is dropped after any result is seen.
No mixing: these rows never enter the RPUF LOI benchmark and Dravix rows never enter these datasets.
No new features: c1-c3 get exactly the published input matrix of each paper (before the paper's own supervised selection unless the config says otherwise).
Third-party data stay in data/sources/incoming/<name>/ (git-ignored apart from SOURCE.md). Workers write experiments/results/samedata_*.json and experiments/runs/samedata_* only.

software.interpreter: ~/dravix/.venv312/bin/python (scikit-learn 1.7.1, numpy 2.2.6, pandas 2.3.3, torch 2.8.0, tabpfn 9.1.0, as installed 2026-10-07). Record pip freeze for these to experiments/runs/samedata_env.txt before the first fit.

c1.name: Dravix LOI recipe (r8d / exp113 model)
c1.definition: equal average of the three predictions: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0, n_jobs=-1); ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0, n_jobs=-1); make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True), StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=10.0))
c1.copied_from: data/v2/train_loi_rescore_r8.py: rf() line 191, et() line 630, ridge() lines 634-635, class Avg lines 617-627 (np.mean of member predictions). Note: min_samples_leaf is 2 for both forests (the brief's '1?' is not the record setting).
c1.input: the dataset's published feature matrix as float64 in file column order; NaN left as NaN (RF/ET are NaN-native in sklearn 1.7.1; Ridge member imputes). No scaling for the forests, no feature selection, no target transform.

c2.name: TabPFN v2 regressor
c2.definition: tabpfn.TabPFNRegressor.create_default_for_version(tabpfn.constants.ModelVersion.V2, device='cpu', random_state=0); nothing else passed; predict(X) default output (mean).
c2.weights_env_licence: exactly as experiments/configs/round9_tabpfn_smearing.json block 'tabpfn_model': V2 regressor checkpoint sha256 2ab5a07d5c41dfe6db9aa7ae106fc6de898326c2765be66505a07e2868c10736 (44,390,977 bytes), HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TABPFN_EXCLUDE_DEVICES=cuda,mps, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, torch.set_num_threads(1). Every result note carries 'Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN'.
c2.input: same matrix as c1, NaN left as NaN, no imputer/scaler.
c2.on_error: any TabPFN exception (incl. the 500-feature or pretraining limits) -> c2 and c3 BLOCKED for that dataset; never retry with ignore_pretraining_limits, another device, precision or version.

c3.name: c1 + c2 blend
c3.definition: (c1 prediction + c2 prediction) / 2, both fit on the same training rows.

candidates_classification (UL-94 configs.c1u: equal average of predict_proba of RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0, n_jobs=-1), ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=0, n_jobs=-1), make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True), StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=5000)); predicted class = argmax of the averaged probabilities (no threshold tuning). C=0.1 = 1/alpha for the Ridge(alpha=10) member, an L2 analogue, not the identical penalty scale.
candidates_classification (UL-94 configs.c2u: tabpfn.TabPFNClassifier.create_default_for_version(ModelVersion.V2, device='cpu', random_state=0); argmax of predict_proba. NEEDS SEPARATE OWNER APPROVAL: round 9 (D3) approved only the V2 regressor checkpoint; the V2 classifier checkpoint, its sha256 and licence must be pinned in an amendment first. Without that, c2u and c3u are not run and the family is {c1u}.
candidates_classification (UL-94 configs.c3u: average of c1u and c2u probabilities; argmax.

protocol_templates.P1_pub: the paper's own single split / folds, reproduced exactly where the config says it can be. Used for the r0 reproduction gate. c1-c3 values on it are printed as information only.
protocol_templates.P1: the paper's split rule (ratio, stratification or grouping, metric, metric aggregation) unchanged, but 10 repeats with random_state = 0..9 instead of their one seed. Per candidate report: mean and SD over the 10 repeats, and the repeat-0 value. Same 10 splits for every candidate and for r0 (paired).
protocol_templates.P2: Dravix protocol, only where a source-paper column exists: data/v2/eval_protocol.repeated_group_kfold(model, X, y, groups) = GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=r), r = 0..9, pooled out-of-fold R2 per repeat; repeat-0 paper-bootstrap 95% CI from eval_protocol.bootstrap_ci(y, oof[0], groups) (2000 draws, seed 0). r0 is run under P2 as well.
protocol_templates.metrics: regression: R2 (primary), RMSE, MAE on the held-out rows; classification: the paper's primary metric plus accuracy, macro-F1 and weighted-F1.

selection_and_comparison_rule.selection: Within each protocol separately, c* = the candidate among c1, c2, c3 (or c1u-c3u) with the highest mean over the 10 repeats (full float precision; exact ties -> listed first). Never by CI, never by repeat 0, never by P1_pub. All three candidates and r0 are always reported.
selection_and_comparison_rule.allowed_sentence_P1: 'On <authors>' data and their protocol (10 random splits instead of their one), Dravix's <c*> reaches mean <metric> X (repeat 0: x0) vs their published Y (their single split); their own model re-run on the same 10 splits gives R0.' Only for c*, only with X, x0, Y and R0 all printed.
selection_and_comparison_rule.allowed_sentence_P2: 'Under Dravix's paper-grouped 5x10 protocol on the same rows: <c*> X2 [ci_lo, ci_hi], their model re-run R2_0.' Never phrased as a win over Y (Y was measured under a different protocol).
selection_and_comparison_rule.paired_context: always print the number of the 10 paired repeats in which c* beats r0 (same splits).
selection_and_comparison_rule.never: 'beats SOTA', 'state of the art', 'outperforms <paper>'. The owner decides any further wording. A dataset whose r0 reproduction gate fails gets no same-protocol sentence at all.

multiplicity_note: Picking the best of 3 candidates by mean inflates the selected mean (winner's curse); with 10 repeats and similar candidates the bias is of the order of the between-candidate spread, so all three are printed next to c*. Across datasets there are up to 5 datasets x 2 protocols (+ UL-94): every drafted dataset is reported in one table whichever way it goes, and none is dropped after results. The published Y is itself one split (often a chosen seed), so X is also compared with R0 (their model, our splits). No p-values, no significance language.
exit_triggers: any c* P1 mean above the published bar, or any P2 ci_lo above it -> FLAG to the owner (blockers/BLOCKER-<ts>-samedata-<name>.md, written by the orchestrator) for wording; nothing is published or added to numbers_of_record.json by a worker.
outputs: experiments/results/samedata_<dataset>_<candidate>_<protocol>.json (plan-section-7 schema fields where they apply; per-repeat metrics included) and experiments/runs/samedata_<dataset>_splits.json (the exact row indices of every split, written before any fit).
